statements.text: President Trump announced a reciprocal energy ceasefire in the war in Ukraine.
The UK has announced new funding to help Ukraine through its fifth winter under Russian bombardment.
The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.
The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 Lightweight Multirole Missiles to Ukraine over four years.
A new UK sanctions package now covers over 90% of Russia's oil producing capacity.
Britain has decided to send air defence and a Voyager aircraft to Saudi Arabia.
The Voyager aircraft sent to Saudi Arabia has completed 14 operational missions.
The Prime Minister set out the UK's latest package of Lightweight Multirole Missiles for Ukraine.
Andy Burnham and Chancellor Merz agreed a new partnership in Berlin to tackle hybrid threats.
The Foreign Affairs Select Committee recommended a National Centre for Information Defence.
Construction of the new Great British Railways headquarters at Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
The headquarters site in Derby will accommodate up to 450 staff.
The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.
Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship, with the first starters based in Derby.

Andy Burnham made an offer to the Scottish Government to work together to empower Scottish regions, and will call on it to develop a new model of regional empowerment for Scotland through No10 North and the Scotland Office.
